Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member, effective immediately, Nvidia announced on November 12, 2026. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor. Shares fell as much as 14% at the open. Nvidia gave no reason; on Sunday it opened an independent investigation into reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. Earnings are still due November 17.
